name: 腫瘍性骨軟化症

summary.text: A rare paraneoplastic syndrome characterized by renal phosphate wasting and bone demineralization due to a phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor of the mixed connective tissue variant. It causes osteomalacia in adults with bone pain and pathological fractures, and rickets in children.
